title: Sample-based KV hit inference and safe threshold rollforward
creator: Ava Chen
description: We need a lightweight, sample-driven estimator for KV/prefix cache hit-rates that supports rapid TTL/policy tuning and a conservative auto-apply workflow. Current TTL tuning is manual and brittle: operators overfit to spike traffic and risk increasing miss rates/cost. This ticket covers design, simulation harness, implementation of an estimator (reservoir + stratified sampling over prefix namespaces and sequence lengths), a safe threshold-based rollforward engine, and Grafana + alerting hooks for human-in-the-loop rollbacks.
tasks: Write design doc: sampling algorithm, metrics to collect, and API for estimator
Build simulator that replays historical request traces and compares estimator with ground truth
Implement estimator library in runtime (C++/Rust) with nightly sampling and exporter hooks
Create safe rollforward controller in control-plane: canary apply, A/B traffic split, progressive TTL delta
Instrument console dashboards and automated alerts for rollback triggers (cost, miss rate, latency)
End-to-end QA on staging and limited customer pilot
Write runbook and rollback playbook for on-call and SRE
acceptance_criteria: Estimator within 5% RMSE of ground-truth hit-rate on held-out traces across 3 workload classes
Safe rollforward canary completes with automated rollback when miss-rate increases > 2.5% absolute or tail latency regresses > 10%
Console shows per-prefix TTL recommendations and a one-click revert with audit log
Performance overhead <2% CPU on serving hosts and sampling memory <4 MB per host
risks: Sampling bias for ultra-low-frequency prefixes can overstate hit-rate; mitigated by stratified sampling and floor TTL
Rollforward controller could oscillate if thresholds too tight; mitigated by hysteresis and minimum wait windows
Telemetry gaps for private deployments (air-gapped) require an alternate on-prem exporter
rollout_plan: Week 1: Merge estimator library behind feature flag and run simulation on replay cluster
Week 2: Enable canary rollforward with 1% traffic for internal customers; monitor for 72 hours
Week 3: Expand to 10% traffic; run customer pilot on 2 mid-market tenants
Week 4: Gradual 25/50/100% if metrics stable; ship runbook and mark Done
